validator.source_text:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: XML declaration is not at the start of the document

primary.message: `<?xml …?>` is only allowed as the very first bytes of the document

notes: the XML declaration must precede everything, even whitespace; elsewhere the name `xml` is reserved and `<?xml` is not well formed
diagnostics.help: remove the blank lines and spaces before `<?xml`
spec_references: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) §2.8 Prolog and Document Type Declaration

fixes.message: remove the whitespace before the XML declaration
